newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Rates quoted amid thin activity.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Rates quoted amid thin activity.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were thinly quoted on Wednesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded versus none on Tuesday.
- Two barges, McGregor and South, Mid-Mississippi River, next week, bid 117-1/2 percent of tariff, no comparison, no offer.
- Two barges, Illinois River, week of August 10, bid 100 percent, no comparison, offer 110 percent, no comparison.
- Four barges, Ohio River, one each week of August 10-31, bid 105 percent, no comparison, offer 117-1/2 percent, no comparison.
- Eight barges, Mid-Mississippi River, two each week of September, bid 170 percent, no comparison, no offer.
